**STEP 7 - Energy:** Dried dates are about 277 kcal per 100 g. Energy ≈ 80 g x 2.77 ≈ 222 kcal.

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** Counting about 20 dates at roughly 6-10 g each gives 120-200 g, so the volume-based estimate of about 80 g is probably low. The pile is loose and I may be underestimating its height. The true weight is likely somewhere between 80 and 150 g, which would put the energy at roughly 220-400 kcal.
